39e008488d99: Demographics: the age pyramid. Ageing affects pensions and the labour market.
4a7e44e1be31: Coalition: partners, their share of seats and mood. Unhappy partners may leave the coalition.
586b35716c41: Social groups and their support for the government. The rating is calculated as a sum weighted by group size. An unhappy group may take to the streets.
59b111425147: Trade and the single market: tariffs, exchange with partners and restrictions.
6000ad1bac9a: Actions within the organization: applications, voting, contributions.
671e3ff00d12: Laws by area. Pick a topic, then a law option. Introducing a law costs political capital and requires votes in parliament.
6c3811dd066f: The population's purchasing power: how many goods can be bought with income.
7496455c6c0d: Defence budget and procurement. More spending means a bigger army, but it weighs on the budget.

7a30225d04b4: Taxes on imported goods. They protect local producers, but make imports more expensive and provoke retaliation.
7a468ad8e4ee: The state's accumulated debts as a percentage of annual GDP. Above 90–100% creditors demand higher interest.
7b16796ad5f5: Actions and transfers for the selected region. They can be applied to several regions at once.
7c6daf135a7e: Country: details. Relations, trade, treaties and available actions.

8986e64f73a5: [color=%s]A window can be moved by its title, resized by its edge, minimised with “–” and closed with “×”. Closed windows come back via the “▦” button. The star adds a window to bookmarks. Ctrl+K searches the whole game.[/color]
8d344e1a1677: The sum of all laws in force: what they give the budget, groups and indicators.

91cf1f29048d: Cabinet of ministers: who holds which ministry. Ministries can be redistributed among the coalition parties.
95b3e5a646e7: Summary of all regions. Click a column header to sort.

a3287377c4d4: Printing money for the budget. While it stays below the safe limit, inflation barely rises. There is no money printing in the eurozone: the ECB prints the money.
a3562d473104: Frequent destinations and your bookmarks (★). A bookmark is added with the star in any window's title bar.
a501842546ca: Protest mood by region. Red means a risk of unrest.
a5f60fc49474: The stock of foreign currency and gold as a percentage of GDP. It helps hold the exchange rate in hard months.
a76df2b0109a: The economy control panel: automation rules, rate, tariffs and measures.
ac16bca57942: Trade and financial restrictions against a country. They hit the economies of both sides and are hard to lift.
ae17f87aac46: Your country has no sea, so “Navy” is hidden. Click to show all tabs.

be8b48520d5f: The selected region: population, mood, economy, autonomy and actions.

c976ac69fbb8: What the organization gives and demands. It also shows how you vote in the organization.

da3b10ecfeae: Bills in progress. You can ask parties for amendments and track voting deadlines.
dc7d60675a7c: War and peace: front, orders, supply. A peace treaty is made step by step.

e9bee771bb5f: Law details: what will change, who is for and against, what it will cost. “Was → will be” shows the three key figures.

efe7b7001338: List of parties. Click a name to see its platform, demands and attitude towards you.

f9dc4817d129: The parliament chamber: parties' seats, the coalition and the head of state. It shows whether the government has a majority.
fd7ec296f521: The share of people without work. It rises in a downturn and falls with growth and subsidies.
